verification_report.summary:
The corrected proof passes the focused sequential audit. The historical hopf_reduction_01 report was read; its accepted geometric and measure deductions were retained, and its input/report and the book were left unchanged. The current replacement resolves its sole SGPT continuity-attribution error.

With d=n-1 and I=integral_B f sigma^d>0, the accepted measure identities and fiber integral 2 give exactly (sigma+ddc v)^d=(c/(2n))f sigma^d. Closed bounded Stokes fixes c=2n/I. Internal thm:kn-continuous applies on the connected compact Hermitian base B=P^d with volume sigma^d and the stated nonnegative Lp density, p>1. Its included proof, audited in weak_lp_existence_01, supplies continuous v and a>0; compactness gives boundedness and Stokes gives a=1/I=c/(2n).

SGPT thm:Yau_rel was checked in the supplied chapter_envelopes.tex, lines 1021–1028, with its contextual definitions. The required arXiv-first/web-fallback search also located the corresponding normalized uniqueness statement in the author's [SGPT, Theorem 3.1.4](https://mingchenxia.github.io/Lectures/SGPT2.pdf#page=90). Here theta=sigma is Kähler and big; P_sigma[0]=0 and its mass is 1, so 0 is a model potential. Bounded v has the singularity type of 0 and full mass by Stokes. The probability measure (f/I)sigma^d is Radon and vanishes on pluripolar sets by absolute continuity. Subtracting suprema permits normalized uniqueness, hence uniqueness modulo constants and its transfer to the bounded descended class. No continuity assertion is inferred from full mass.

For smooth positive f, internal thm:tw-smooth applies with F=log f and gives smooth v with scalar e^b=1/I. Its supplied proof uses the audited smooth_czero_01 and smooth_second_estimate_01 estimates. The internal theorems include base dimension one, so n=2 is valid and gives c=4/I. Operator and volume conventions agree, with no extra factors. The exponential paragraph correctly asserts only the same measure reduction; genuinely fiber-dependent data do not have that form. No new external Lp theorem or additional repair is needed.
